sources.title: RFC 9457 — Problem Details for HTTP APIs
Stripe Engineering — Designing robust and predictable APIs with idempotency

coverage.taughtAt: Three V3 segments on bounded query, body and idempotency validation
coverage.assessedAt: Five local quiz questions plus real Node HTTP fixture with 21 invalid requests and replay/conflict proofs
coverage.evidenceExpected: Invalid pagination, huge limit, oversized JSON, forbidden fields produce stable errors without writes; identical key/body replays 201, different payload gets 409.

coverage.taughtAt: Independent sort, forbidden nested input and currency-mismatch cases
coverage.assessedAt: Independent Project and exact state-counter proof
coverage.evidenceExpected: New adversarial input is rejected with a stable Problem Details response and no mutation.
